items.title: The Hawks have a +3.1 net rating overall this season.
items.author: Brad Rowland
items.body_excerpt:
The Hawks have a +3.1 net rating overall this season.

Every single player has an OFF-court net rating of +1.3 or better.... except Dyson Daniels.

Atlanta has a -5.4 net rating with Dyson on the bench.

Jumps to +7.8 with Daniels on the floor, best of any Hawk with 75+ minutes.
